personal.name: Spoorthy K.R.
personal.tagline: Hi, I'm Spoorthy. I build intelligent systems that connect AI research with production-grade software, from agentic RAG and financial disclosure search to deep learning models for signal detection and medical imaging. Previously a Software Engineer at JPMorgan Chase, I engineered high-volume financial infrastructure; now I'm bringing that systems mindset to agentic AI at Jefferies.

highlights: Designed Spring Boot microservices replacing a 40-year-old mainframe processing 250–300k daily FX trades worth $10–15B
Converted REST APIs to GraphQL reducing frontend load time by ~100ms
Migrated Oracle databases to secure cloud with minimal downtime
Built Python automation tools saving the QA team 7–8 hours weekly
Raised SonarQube security score from 65% to 80%+ and embedded it in CI/CD
Led end-to-end development of a real-time Kubernetes microservices monitoring platform
Implemented dynamic pod scaling, live log streaming, and health monitoring
Cut resolution time by 40% with real-time failure alerts
Built NLP preprocessing pipeline with spaCy/NLTK for symbolic report parsing
Trained Random Forest & SVM models achieving 85%+ accuracy on EV testing data
Reduced manual test instruction effort by 60%

projects.title: Constraint-Aware Financial Disclosure Search Engine
projects.subtitle: CSCE 670 · Information Retrieval System
projects.description: Passage-level SEC 10-K search engine for S&P 100 financial disclosures that combines BM25 lexical retrieval, FinBERT-style dense search, OpenSearch hybrid ranking, and structured constraints over year, sector, geography, ticker, and company. Returns citable evidence passages with transparent score breakdowns, mismatch penalties, and coverage-aware ingestion for missing filings.

projects.title: Critic-Guided Iterative RAG for QA
projects.subtitle: CSCE 638 · Agentic RAG Research
projects.description: Agentic retrieval framework that improves RAG reliability by using an LLM critic to evaluate context sufficiency, rewrite weak queries, and iteratively retrieve better evidence before answer generation. Compared baseline, iterative, and agentic RAG pipelines across SQuAD v2.0, HotpotQA, and 2WikiMultihopQA.

projects.title: Signal Detection in RSMA
projects.subtitle: IEEE NCC 2023 — Lead Author
projects.description: LSTM-based signal detection for beyond-5G networks using Rate-Splitting Multiple Access. Outperforms conventional algorithms in noisy, multi-user channels using temporal sequence modeling to minimize bit error rates.

projects.title: Radiogenomic Brain Tumor Classification
projects.subtitle: IEEE INDICON 2022 — Lead Author
projects.description: Transfer learning with ResNet & AlexNet to predict IDH genetic biomarker status from MRI scans, enabling chemotherapy response prediction. Achieved 82% accuracy on the RSNA-MICCAI dataset via 3D slice extraction and advanced augmentation.

projects.title: AI-Powered Document Classifier
projects.subtitle: LLM + OCR Document Processing API
projects.description: FastAPI service that processes PDF uploads, extracts text with PyMuPDF and OCR fallback, computes page-level legibility signals, and classifies documents using local LLM inference through Ollama. Includes a Swagger API interface and deployed Heroku endpoint for interactive testing.

projects.title: NLP Topic Summarizer
projects.subtitle: Multi-source Summarization Platform
projects.description: BART transformer-powered platform that scrapes raw web content via BeautifulSoup, then generates coherent multi-source topic overviews using abstractive summarization. Deployed with an interactive Flask frontend.
